name: S. G. Smith
role: Superintendent of the Medora stage line
bio: S. G. Smith of Bismarck became superintendent of the stage company in February 1885. By December 1886 he was living at Menoken, Dakota.

moments.label: Named superintendent of the stage company

mentions: W. D. Simpson returned from St. Paul, and S. G. Smith from Bismarck, last evening.
J. P. Elverson is now acting as agent for the stage company here, and S G. Smith, of Bismarck, as superintendent.
…who will be proprietor. Several names have been mentioned, among the most prominent are H. M. Jorgins, S. G. Smith and Arch. Boyd.
